posts.text:
When a public official is absent for an extended period of time, the public has a right to an honest explanation.

I'm introducing the Duty of Transparency Act to require Members to disclose extended absences so constituents know where their representative is.
posts.summary: Introduces transparency bill requiring disclosure of extended absences

A young man is dead because an ICE agent pulled the trigger in Biddeford, Maine. He was 26. 

Behind every headline like this is a family whose lives have been shattered. The callousness of this administration's immigration agenda has a body count.
posts.summary: Criticizes ICE agent shooting, condemns administration immigration enforcement

posts.text:
Proud that five of my provisions in the bipartisan 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act are now the law of the land.

President Trump called the bill "a big yawn" and refused to sign it. The American people struggling to afford a home know better, and so did the bipartisan majorities who passed it.

As a son of the Bronx raised in public housing, this is personal and real progress for families who need it.
posts.summary: Defends bipartisan housing bill against Trump criticism

Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was a husband, father, and hardworking member of his community who spent decades building a life for his family. He was shot and killed by an ICE officer on his way to work.

His family deserves transparency, accountability, and an independent investigation.

posts.text: Today, I returned to the Hub in the South Bronx to assess conditions firsthand and ensure the city is following through on the public safety measures I fought for. We must continue working to make this neighborhood safer and stronger for everyone who calls it home.

You can't slash Medicaid funding for the neediest among us AND defund the people truly fighting fraud while claiming to champion "government efficiency." Hypocrisy of the highest order.

The Supreme Court has spoken and upheld that birthright citizenship is guaranteed by the 14th Amendment. It was settled law 128 years ago in Wong Kim Ark, and it remains settled law today.

Donald Trump's executive order was blatantly unconstitutional and sought to fundamentally undermine the fabric of America.
posts.summary: Rejects Trump's birthright citizenship executive order as unconstitutional
